lines.text: Firefighters in full gear operate at night on a multi-story building with visible smoke and fire damage. Multiple fire trucks with extended ladders are positioned around the structure. An American flag is displayed prominently. Emergency personnel are gathered, and a street sign indicates '12147 P' with parking restrictions. The scene is illuminated by emergency lights against a dark sky.
